scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: EPF Reimbursement
other_conditions: Minimum investment of ₹2,500 crore in plant and machinery.
Must provide direct employment to at least 2,500 persons.
Must belong to one of the thrust sectors defined in the Guidelines.
Only new employees without a Universal Account Number (UAN) before joining are eligible.
Reimbursement applies only to incremental employee count post‑expansion.
benefits_summary: 100% reimbursement of the employer’s EPF contribution, capped at 12% of basic salary + DA or ₹1800 per month, whichever is lower.
